_note: The CLOSED list of the jobs that may hold id-token: write (their own permissions, or the workflow's when they set none). Signing with the release key needs the job's OIDC token (it is exchanged for the signing role's short-lived credentials), so bin/chain-sign-wiring-test.sh fails for any job holding it that is not listed, and for a listed job that no longer holds it (REQ-CHAIN-001-AC1). The list is data: review of a change to it is the control.

jobs.reason: mints a federated OIDC identity token for the auditor's model vendor (github-script getIDToken); signs nothing
the scanner panel's probe: keyless federation to the panel's vendors, publishes nothing
the Dependabot reviewer's OIDC federation to its model vendor; signs nothing
aws-actions/configure-aws-credentials: OIDC federation to the AWS Inspector role
google-github-actions/auth: OIDC federation to Google for the scanner panel
Sign: the one provenance signer; it holds the identity token for the release key and builds nothing (REQ-CHAIN-001)
Sign's second job: checks and signs the Rebuild records with the release key and receives no Rebuild apk or image (REQ-CHAIN-005-AC4)
Sign's third job: checks and signs the Check records of both chips with the release key (REQ-REL-011-AC1)

Sign's fourth job, after release publishes: it alone holds the release key's role for the signatures and attestations of the published images and apks (REQ-CHAIN-007-AC3); the release job holds no identity token
aws-actions/configure-aws-credentials: OIDC federation to the AWS Inspector role
OpenSSF Scorecard publishes its results with the job's OIDC token

the job-level call of persona-uat.yml on a release candidate: the called file's job mints a federated identity token for the model provider in the persona-uat environment (REQ-UAT-001-AC1); it signs no provenance and publishes nothing

Persona UAT, release-candidate run, called by release.yml (REQ-UAT-001-AC1): a federated identity token for the model provider in the persona-uat environment; it signs no provenance and publishes nothing; contents read, no registry credential
Persona UAT, weekly run (REQ-UAT-001): the same federation in the persona-uat environment; it signs no provenance and publishes nothing; contents read, no registry credential
the rule-12 live test on a release candidate (REQ-SCAN-012): the same federation into the dedicated live-test accounts only (environment live-test), after Check; signs and publishes nothing
the rule-12 live test right after a final release is published (REQ-SCAN-012): the same federation (environment live-test); signs and publishes nothing
the call of release.yml in snapshot mode: id-token is the ceiling the caller grants (REQ-CHAIN-004-AC14); no called job holds it in that mode
the call of release.yml in snapshot mode: id-token is the ceiling the caller grants (REQ-CHAIN-004-AC14); no called job holds it in that mode
